title: Hom-set
description: JSON Schema for a hom-set Hom_C(A, B) — the set of morphisms from object A to object B in category C (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. I §2; Awodey 2010 §1.4). Carries the source and target objects together with the collection of morphisms between them; uniqueItems: true on the morphisms array enforces no duplicates.

in-category.description: The category C in which this hom-set is taken.

source-object.description: The source object A — the domain of every morphism in this hom-set.

target-object.description: The target object B — the codomain of every morphism in this hom-set.

morphisms.description: The morphisms from source-object to target-object. Each morphism's domain and codomain must agree with source-object and target-object respectively (transformer-level check).
